title: Groceries or School Cafeterias: How Households Respond to School Nutrition Mandates
eligible_reason: Single nationwide treatment date (HHFKA nutrition standards, treatment start set to August 2012 for all treated households; window Aug 2011 - Jul 2013). Treated = households with school-age children (6-12), control = households without children, coarsened-exact matched. Equation 1 uses household FE plus county x month FE (additional nonredundant FE), so it is a 2x2 design with matching: not staggered and not eligible.
design_notes: Eq. (1): DV_ht = beta (TreatGroup_h x TreatPer_t) + delta_h + lambda_ct + eps; DV = log calories per adult-equivalent per day (Table 2 col 1: effect -.064) and Nutrient Profile Score. NielsenIQ Consumer Panel + Label Insight; 34,793 households after CEM (7,645 treated, 27,148 control). SE clustered by household. Heterogeneity tables use treatment-by-characteristic interactions.
estimators_reported: DiD with household FE and county-by-month FE on CEM sample
screener_notes: Ineligible: single adoption date, matching, county x month FE. Data: NielsenIQ Consumer Panel (licensed) and Label Insight; no package in batch.
